implementation.batch_case_contract: Approved <=500 unique nonzero inbox UUIDs, sorted JSON input; current actor/tenant/session/membership and write/active flags; caller-transaction case provider, missing/NULL fail closed. Consumer only, no owner provider or activation.

implementation.target_boundary: Separate MySQL response adapters expose generation/cancellation/replay. Strict bounded cancellation requires explicit expected_generation and rejects duplicate/unknown keys. Authorized read/cancel operations verify caller tenant/scenario before UUID-only mutation. Creation/admission, inline waiting and route activation remain open.
